title: 第11章 血染乱流诸敌环伺第12章 焦土囚笼万魔血擂
slug: 噬主成魔万魂幡饮血开锋
content_zh:
阴九幽残破的骨架在空间乱流的狂暴撕扯下发出刺耳的呻吟，新生的暗金血肉如同破布般被不断剥离，露出下面布满裂痕的骨骼。
万魂幡悬浮在他身前，漆黑恨焰魂火剧烈摇曳，勉强撑开一个不断被压缩的暗金光罩，抵御着乱流中足以湮灭筑基修士的恐怖能量风暴。
吞噬阴骨老人带来的短暂力量，在穿越空间乱流和对抗血公子、枯骨禅师的阻击中，已然消耗大半。
“桀桀…魔崽子，你还能撑多久？”
血公子阴魂不散的声音如同毒蛇般钻入阴九幽的神魂。
一道粘稠污秽的血河虚影，无视了部分空间乱流，如同跗骨之蛆般缠绕在万魂幡的光罩上，疯狂腐蚀着漆黑恨焰。
“你的血，本公子要定了！”
另一边，枯骨禅师的身影在乱流中若隐若现，他并未直接攻击，而是双手合十，口中念念有词。
诡异的金色梵文化作实质的锁链，穿透乱流，无声无息地缠绕向阴九幽的骨架！
这是枯骨寺的秘传禁术——“梵骨锁魂链”
一旦被缠上，不仅肉身化为枯骨，神魂也将被强行度化、禁锢，成为对方修炼邪佛功法的资粮！
金无赦虽然暂时退去，但阴九幽能感觉到，一道冰冷刺骨的剑意如同毒蛇之信，在乱流之外遥遥锁定着自己，随时可能发出致命一击。
这三人，如同附骨之疽，根本不给阴九幽丝毫喘息的机会！
“想要？那就…拿命来换！”
阴九幽眼中恨焰暴涨，灵魂疯狂催动万魂幡！
漆黑恨焰魂火猛地向外一涨，如同泼了滚油的火堆！
“恨火…焚天！”
轰！
缠绕在光罩上的污秽血河虚影瞬间被点燃！
冰冷漆黑的恨焰如同遇到了最佳的燃料，疯狂蔓延、焚烧！

血河污血中蕴含的怨念、腐蚀之力，竟被恨焰强行炼化、吸收，反过来壮大了自身！
“什么？！”
血公子猩红的眼眸闪过一丝惊怒，他感觉到自己与那道血河分魂的联系正在被强行切断、焚烧！
他急忙掐诀，想要收回，却已经晚了！
嗤啦！
污秽血河被漆黑恨焰彻底焚尽、吞噬！
万魂幡的魂火反而壮大了几分！
“邪魔外道，冥顽不灵！
看我佛光普度！”
枯骨禅师见血河被破，眼中贪婪更甚，口中梵音骤然拔高！
那些金色的梵文锁链瞬间凝实，如同无数条金色的毒蛇，无视恨焰的焚烧（虽然被灼烧得滋滋作响），狠狠缠绕上了阴九幽裸露的暗金骨架！
咔！
咔！
咔！
令人牙酸的摩擦声响起！
梵骨锁魂链蕴含着诡异的度化与枯骨之力，疯狂侵蚀着阴九幽的骨骼！
暗金骨骼上的裂痕瞬间扩大，发出不堪重负的呻吟！
更可怕的是，锁链上传来一股强大的吸力，竟在强行抽取他骨骼中蕴含的那丝王魂本源和新生血肉的生命力！
同时，歹毒的度化之力如同钢针，狠狠刺向他的神魂！
“呃啊！”

阴九幽骨架剧颤，魂火摇曳！
肉身与神魂同时遭受重创！
新生的血肉以肉眼可见的速度干瘪、枯萎！
“秃驴！
content_en:
Yin Jiuyou's broken skeleton let out a harsh groan as the violent turbulent flow of space tore it apart. The new dark gold flesh and blood was peeled off like rags, revealing the cracked bones underneath.
The Ten Thousand Soul Banner was suspended in front of him, and the dark flames of hatred and soul fire swayed violently, barely holding open a dark golden light shield that was constantly being compressed, resisting the terrifying energy storm in the turbulence that could annihilate the foundation-building monks.
Most of the short-term power brought by devouring the Yin Bone Old Man has been consumed by the turbulent flow through space and the resistance against Young Master Xue and Zen Master Dry Bones.
"Jie Jie... Devil bastard, how long can you hold on?"
Young Master Xue's haunting voice penetrated into Yin Jiuyou's soul like a poisonous snake.
A viscous and dirty shadow of the blood river ignored part of the turbulent flow in space, entangled around the light shield of the Ten Thousand Soul Flag like tarsal maggots, and crazily corroded the dark flames of hatred.
"Your blood will be decided by me!"
On the other side, the figure of Zen Master Dry Bones loomed in the turbulence. He did not attack directly, but clasped his hands together and muttered something.
The weird golden Sanskrit as a substantial chain penetrates the turbulent flow and wraps around Xiang Yin Jiuyou's frame silently!
This is the secret forbidden technique of Dry Bone Temple - "Brahma Bone Soul Locking Chain"
Once entangled, not only the physical body will be turned into withered bones, but the soul will also be forcibly converted and imprisoned, becoming the material for the opponent to practice the evil Buddha technique!
Although Jin Wushe temporarily retreated, Yin Jiuyou could feel that a cold and biting sword intent was like a poisonous snake's letter, locking itself far away from the turbulent flow, and it could deliver a fatal blow at any time.
These three people were like gangrene attached to their bones, not giving Yin Jiuyou any chance to breathe!
"Want it? Then... risk your life in exchange!"
Flames of hatred surged in Yin Jiuyou's eyes, and his soul crazily activated the Ten Thousand Soul Flags!
The dark soul flame of hatred suddenly swelled outward, like a fire poured with boiling oil!
"Hate fire...burn the sky!"
Boom!
The filthy blood river shadow wrapped around the light mask was instantly ignited!
The cold and dark flames of hatred seemed to have encountered the best fuel, spreading and burning crazily!
The resentment and corrosive power contained in the dirty blood of the Blood River were forcibly refined and absorbed by Hate Flame, which in turn strengthened itself!
"What?!"
Young Master Xue's scarlet eyes flashed with a trace of shock and anger. He felt that his connection with the blood-river soul was being forcibly cut off and burned!
He hurriedly made a seal and wanted to take it back, but it was already too late!
Tsk!
The river of filthy blood was completely burned and swallowed up by the dark flames of hatred!
The soul fire of the Ten Thousand Soul Banner has grown a bit stronger!
"The evil heretics are stubborn and ineffective!
Look at my Buddha’s light! "
Seeing the river of blood being broken, Zen Master Kugu's eyes became even more greedy, and the Sanskrit sounds in his mouth suddenly rose higher!
Those golden Sanskrit chains solidified in an instant, like countless golden snakes, ignoring the burning of the flames of hatred (although they were burned with a sizzling sound), and tightly wrapped around Yin Jiuyou's exposed dark gold skeleton!
Click!
Click!
Click!
A teeth-searing friction sound sounded!
The Brahma Bone Soul Locking Chain contains the strange power of transformation and withered bones, which crazily erodes Yin Jiuyou's bones!
The cracks on the dark gold bones expanded instantly, and he let out an overwhelmed groan!
What's even more frightening is that there is a strong suction force coming from the chain, which is actually forcibly extracting the vitality of the king's soul and the new flesh and blood contained in his bones!
At the same time, the vicious power of transformation was like a steel needle, piercing his soul!
"Uh-huh!"
Yin Jiuyou's skeleton trembled, and his soul fire swayed!
The body and soul suffered heavy injuries at the same time!
The new flesh and blood shriveled and withered at a speed visible to the naked eye!
"Bald donkey!
